floorPlans.note: Confirm the signed layout and total area for the individual home. The brochure drawings do not give a measured whole-unit area.

review.images: Residence and amenity renders extracted from the official brochure for Al Ghadeer Gardens N2. Aldar uses some shared neighbourhood, elevation and interior art across both Gardens brochures. Shared facilities are labelled as such and the card uses this release’s selected lead view.
review.location: Visually checked all four estimates on physical page 6 of this release’s brochure. The same schematic appears in both releases. The map shows area connections via Al Fayah Road and does not locate individual gates.
review.floorPlans: Four complete sheets on physical pages 40–43 reviewed. The official N2 brochure replaces the launch’s three-bedroom middle sheet with the two-bedroom corner sheet. No three-bedroom middle layout was carried over from the first release. No signed area is printed beside the individual drawings.

unavailable: Verified entrance coordinates and unit-specific signed total areas.
